n: <int> Number of securities in the investment universe.
k: <int> Maximum number of securities that may receive a positive allocation in the portfolio.
r: <int> Number of factors used in the factor model for the covariance structure.
gamma: <float> Ridge regularization parameter that penalizes concentrated portfolio positions.
gamma_formula: <str> Formula used to compute gamma from n.
kappa: <int> Multiplier controlling whether expected returns appear in the objective (1) or are handled via a separate minimum-return constraint (0).
mu: <list[float], length n> Expected monthly return for each security.
factor_loadings: <list[list[float]], shape [n][r]> Factor loading matrix whose outer product contributes the systematic component of the covariance matrix.
idiosyncratic_variance: <list[float], length n> Per-security idiosyncratic variance forming the diagonal component of the covariance matrix.

constraints.has_min_return_constraint: <bool> Whether the portfolio must achieve a minimum expected return.
constraints.r_bar: <float or null> Minimum required expected portfolio return, or null if no such constraint applies.
constraints.has_min_investment_constraint: <bool> Whether each selected security must receive at least a minimum allocation.
constraints.l_min_investment: <list[float] or null, length n> Minimum allocation required for each security if it is included in the portfolio, or null if no minimum investment constraint applies.
constraints.u_max_investment: <list[float] or null, length n> Maximum allocation allowed for each security if it is included in the portfolio, or null if no maximum investment constraint applies.
